snippet.title: WHAT THE STARS FORGOT REVEAL  - Developer Interview and Airlock Games Announcement
snippet.description:
Today we are excited to announce our first game here at Airlock Games "What The Stars Forgot"

Take a deep dive into the game and the beginning of our new adventures at Airlock Games with Co-founders Justin Fischer and Brock Feldman

What The Stars Forgot is a game where you are doing everything to can to try and save as many crew members of the ship as possible. Use everything you have to keep the ship running, the crew happy, and the monsters away.

Let us know what you think in the comments section below about the game and thoughts for whats to come with Airlock Games!!

For more updates follow our Twitter:  @airlock_games  
Join our discord: Airlock Games

Check out our Kickstarter page here!!: https://bit.ly/AirlockGames-WTSF
